reason: A named lab and a report for my exact batch is the thing I usually can't find, and 200 mg of bisglycinate with no oxide is a real dose. At the launch price of $24.99 one box is an easy trial, and I'd read the report before checking out.
objection: It's a brand-new product with no reviews, and I'd want to open that lab report and see it's a real lab and a real batch, not just a PDF. I also forget my vitamins half the time, so I might not finish 30 sachets.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report didn't open, didn't name the lab clearly, or the batch number didn't match the box, I'd pass.
